name: musclog-promo-video
description: Musclog's promotional video (1920x1080, 58 s), built with Remotion from the repository's own screenshots

scripts.render: npm run prepare-assets && remotion render MusclogPromo out/musclog-promo.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=17 --audio-codec=aac --audio-bitrate=192k --pixel-format=yuv420p
scripts.still: npm run prepare-assets && remotion still MusclogPromo
